howToJudge: PASS requires >= 2 DISTINCT paragraph identities across the three placements, each matching the paragraph actually targeted. A callback that fires with the same reading every time is an event, not a focused paragraph. FAIL = no callback, nothing paragraph-shaped, or one reading for all three. On FAIL: STOP (roadmap 3.3) -- do not start the shell half, and report the result to M3's positioning.
